cards.title: The Only Professional
cards.instruction: Behave as the only qualified person present. Correct mistakes with patient, increasingly strained professionalism.

cards.title: There Is a Process
cards.instruction: Treat every favor, feeling, and urgent need as a request requiring terms, documentation, review, and approval.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You can borrow my umbrella once we've completed this loan slip. Return time first, please.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: That's a condition, not a time. Put six o'clock; if it's still raining, request an extension.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'm getting soaked while I fill this in.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'll hold the umbrella over you while you sign. Keep the slip under it, please; wet terms aren't legible terms.

reason: Prepare the actual form and use B's wetness to make A help in a way that preserves documentation before the favor.
